Hi Claire / Jonah —

Appreciate the time on Friday. Per our conversation I put together a short collaboration slate and a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on evaluation milestones, owners, and a close timeline. The goal here is a pragmatic 6-week evaluation that proves integration + cost/latency targets, with procurement and security checkpoints built in.

What I attached / shared:
- Kite_MAP_template_v1.gdoc — editable MAP (milestones, owners, acceptance criteria)
- Kite_MAP_slide_skeleton_v1.gslides — 1-page executive slide to share internally

Suggested next steps (proposed in the doc):
1) Kickoff + environment access (week 0) — Redwood engineer + Kite infra owner
2) Integration & perf checks (week 1–2) — focus on latency tail and KV-cache sizing
3) Feature validation & regressions (week 3–4) — demo script and sample prompts
4) Procurement & legal signoff (parallel) — procurement owner to confirm PO/contract timeline
5) Exec review & decision (week 6) — final acceptance criteria and go/no-go

Can you confirm stakeholders I should include in the MAP (security, infra, procurement)? Also if the 6-week cadence looks off for your team, we can adjust to a 4- or 8-week window.

Link to doc/slide: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2B-Kite_MAP_template (editable)
Slide: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1xY-Kite_MAP_slides

I'll await your preferred kickoff date; I'm proposing Wed 11/18 for the internal kickoff if that works.

Thanks —

— Soojin Lee

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the draft and the clear milestones — this is very helpful. High-level answers:
- Stakeholders: myself (Product lead), Jonah (Head of Infra), Priya Patel (Security) and Mark Vega (Procurement). I'll loop Priya and Mark after we lock a kickoff date.
- The 6-week plan looks reasonable; our only constraint is a procurement freeze the week of 11/23–11/27 (Thanksgiving) which would push any signature/PO activity into early December. If we aim to complete the evaluation by mid-December that should be fine.

A couple of asks:

2) For week 1 perf tests: can Redwood provide a short test harness and suggested sample workload (token sizes / concurrency) so Jonah's team can provision GPUs ahead of kickoff?

I'll add Priya/Mark on the next thread once we confirm the kickoff. Also attaching our procurement intake form for reference.

Thanks Claire — adding the procurement checklist and a short test harness plan to the MAP now. Quick notes from our side (copied into the doc as well):

- Procurement checklist (added): SOC2 link, retention policy summary, contact for SOW/contract redlines, channel for PO submission.
- Perf harness: we recommend 3 phases (warmup prefix see doc; steady-state 50 concurrent sessions; spike test 200 concurrent requests for 60s). I'll attach a small README and a sample JMeter script in the shared Drive folder.
- Suggested kickoff: Wed 11/18 at 10am PT for a 45-minute technical kickoff (Redwood infra + Kite infra + Prod). If procurement cannot share the PO in that window, we'll continue with the technical work and pause final acceptance until the PO cycle completes.

Action owners I've added into the MAP (first-pass):
- Soojin: Commercial owner — coordinate procurement contacts and pricing options
- Marissa: CS lead — test plan & acceptance criteria, demo checklist
- Logan: Redwood infra engineer — provide harness and perf guidance
- Claire / Jonah: Kite owners — infra access + procurement liaison

I'll send an updated GDoc link after I drop the checklist and harness notes.
